Aligned opcode scan is discovery only; unverified candidates are not code proof.
Four nonactive dump Copper finds do not establish all possible dynamic lists.
Other executable a is not a HUNK_HEADER image; not treated as the running Shot CODE.
Unrelated blank-name disk file data not read; do not claim whole-disk data-chain validity.
Native mainloop cadence remains open; busy counts are audio-tick units, not measured milliseconds.
Teardown passes SetIntVector arguments0x80/0x200 rather than setup7/9; intent apparent, correct restoration NOT proven.
No game source, DAT, PRG or D81 generated/modified.
